title: Remote viewing a hidden power that pushes for one world government to prepare humanity for space
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Remote viewing a hidden power that pushes for one world government to prepare humanity for space, about present to future at Earth, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the powers that actually are behind the governments and run the governments uh want us to have one world, one government to prepare us for space.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant who worked as a remote viewer, meaning someone trained to perceive distant or hidden things with the mind, says his viewing revealed hidden powers that stand behind and run the world's governments. According to Buchanan, these powers want humanity under one world government to prepare us for life in space. If true, it would mean the world's politics are being steered toward a plan most people know nothing about.
